hooks.name: Run Module Tests on Service Change
hooks.description: Run API module tests when a service file inside apps/api/src/modules is saved

action.command: cd /home/chazy/Desktop/projects/software-firm/youtube-content-studio && FILE="$1" && if echo "$FILE" | grep -q "apps/api/src/modules"; then MODULE=$(echo "$FILE" | sed 's|.*/modules/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|'); pnpm --filter @repo/api test -- --reporter=verbose 2>&1 | tail -30; fi
